residual_limits: Real BJT settings changes, real sensors/PLCs/lamps and long printing runs were not tested. Synthetic UI timing is not a real-equipment performance or safety guarantee.
Actual Excel COM was unavailable. Private Excel reset/integration behavior is covered by offline/mock tests and unchanged worker source, not a real Excel run.
Final control algorithm approval and equipment application remain explicitly on hold; this review does not lift them.

After settings/UI HOLD, a complete visible Sequence inventory and saved/UI agreement are required. Unsaved edits or unavailable/ambiguous controls can keep the connection in HOLD indefinitely; the module does not navigate, Save or revert automatically.
Any possible IR edit/Save, unknown apply failure or outcome uncertainty remains terminal; no automatic retry or rollback is authorized.
CSV timestamps and normal-looking values cannot independently establish physical sensor freshness. Image patterns do not prove binder execution, sensor location, drying or physical process state.
The actual M1 job log was not supplied for recorded-CSV replay; contexts/clock were reconstructed from the screenshot/filenames/row times. The original first disconnection cause remains unknown.
Read-only audit and preflight checks are bounded observations, not an atomic lock against all operator/device changes. Unsaved edits outside audited controls retain existing limitations.
Pillow getdata deprecation appears in a test; runtime is pinned to Pillow13. Known Tcl teardown warnings are not represented as warning-free execution.
